data.title: Bitmine boosts Ethereum holdings to 5.85M, near... | Pluang
data.description: Bitmine Immersion Technologies increased its Ethereum holdings by 32,447 ETH, bringing its total to 5,847,611 tokens, close to controlling 5% of Ethereum's circulating supply. The company has staked about 87% of its Ethereum, generating significant annualized staking revenue. This expansion supports Bitmine's treasury strategy, linking asset accumulation with recurring income. Bitmine remains the largest public Ethereum treasury, benefiting from Ethereum's recent 30% price surge.
